_说明: viewer3d.html?model=cathedral 的清单（精简版：只有低档 glb，glb 与 glb_low 同一文件）。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米；Blender (x, y, z) → (x, z, -y)）。由 blender/landmarks/cathedral/build.py + blender/landmarks/export_glb.py 生成。

credit.zh: 自建模型；贴图 Poly Haven / ambientCG（CC0）
credit.en: Own model; textures Poly Haven / ambientCG (CC0)

desc.zh: 哥特式西立面：两座方塔带三段收分的角扶壁，上接八角钟楼层和镂空石尖塔（八根角肋、水平环与圆形窗花，塔尖约 118 m）。双塔之间是主门、玫瑰窗和尖山墙；三个门洞都是层层内收的尖拱券，门楣上有尖山花。
desc.en: Gothic west front: two square towers with stepped corner buttresses, octagonal belfry stages and openwork stone spires (eight ribs, horizontal rings and round tracery; tips about 118 m). Between them are the main portal, the rose window and a pointed gable; all three portals have receding pointed orders under gables.

desc.zh: 中殿、唱诗堂和后殿外侧的扶壁墩与双层飞扶壁：拱券把高墙拱顶的侧推力越过侧廊屋顶传到外侧墩上，墩顶的小尖塔增加压重。
desc.en: Piers and double flying buttresses along the nave, choir and apse: the arches carry the outward thrust of the high vaults over the aisle roofs to the outer piers, whose pinnacles add weight.

desc.zh: 交叉处方座上的鼓座：外围 32 根柱的柱廊、16 个圆拱窗，上承铜绿穹顶、16 道镀金肋和镀金采光亭。
desc.en: Over the crossing, a drum ringed by a 32-column colonnade with 16 round-headed windows carries a verdigris dome with 16 gilded ribs and a gilded lantern.

desc.zh: 南北耳堂端墙各有一扇玫瑰窗（放射窗棂 + 圆形窗花）、一个内收尖拱门和角部扶壁尖塔。
desc.en: Each transept end has a rose window (radiating tracery with foiled circles), a receding pointed portal and pinnacled corner buttresses.

desc.zh: 东端半圆后殿，外绕一圈较低的回廊，三个多边形小礼拜堂向外放射，各有锥形屋顶和尖拱窗。
desc.en: The semicircular east apse is wrapped by a lower ambulatory with three polygonal chapels radiating from it, each with a conical roof and lancet windows.

desc.zh: 教堂南侧的方形回廊：四面走廊是扇形拱顶（等曲率肋从束柱展开），朝庭院一侧是带窗花的尖拱廊。庭院中央有八角井台，墙上有壁灯；大主教常在深夜沿回廊散步。
desc.en: A square cloister south of the church: the four walks have fan vaults (ribs of equal curvature spreading from wall shafts) and open onto the garth through traceried pointed arcades. An octagonal well-head stands in the centre and lanterns hang on the walls; the archbishop often walks here late at night.

desc.zh: 回廊南侧的三层石砌府邸：石竖棂窗、滴水罩、板岩坡顶和成排烟囱，经南回廊与教堂相连。
desc.en: A three-storey stone residence on the south side of the cloister, with stone-mullioned windows, hood moulds, a slate roof and chimney stacks, linked to the church through the south walk.
